Class MilitaryTechShockEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier2.historical.MilitaryTechShockEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class MilitaryTechShockEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Military Revolution & Tactical Shock Engine.

Models historical military revolutions (Parker 1996, Roberts 1956) where pyrotechnic and metallurgical breakthroughs induce intense military capital investments and mobilization.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3

      public void accumulateCellularDerivatives(WorldBuffer buffer, int i, double dtYears, double dtMonthly, DerivativeAccumulator acc)
      Description copied from interface: SimulationEngineModule
      Accumulates local derivative increments for a single cell slot during the fused DoD pass.
      Parameters:
      buffer - contiguous world memory buffer
      i - index of the cell in the contiguous buffer
      dtYears - elapsed time step in Julian years
      dtMonthly - elapsed time step as a monthly fraction
      acc - target derivative accumulator
